189     def start(self):
190         """
191         Execute the chain.
192         :return: the result of the chain.
193         """
194         try:
195             is_running = True
196             while is_running:
197                 # project requirement setup
198                 if self.plan.requirement:
199                     self.console.print(f"[cyan]User Requirement:[/cyan] {self.plan.requirement}")
200                 else:
201                     self.requirement = questionary.text("Hi, what are your requirements?").ask()
202                     self.plan.requirement = self.requirement
203                 if self.entry_file is None:
204                     if self.requirement:
205                         self.entry_file = self.gen_file_name(self.requirement)
206                         if self.entry_file is None:
207                             raise SystemExit("The file name is not generated.")
208                         self.console.print(f"Project requirements updated to: {self.project_setting_file}")
209                         self.update_project_state()
210 
211                 if not self.requirement:
212                     raise SystemExit("The user requirement is not provided.")
213 
214                 # working on the task content.
215                 if self.plan.tasks is None:
216                     self.console.log(f"The project [cyan]{self.project_name}[/cyan] has no existing plans. "
217                                      f"Start planning...")
218 
219                     ml_task_name = req_based_generator(self.requirement, pmpt_task_select(), self.agent)
220                     self.console.print(f"[cyan]Task detected:[/cyan] {ml_task_name}")
221                     ml_model_arch = req_based_generator(self.requirement, pmpt_model_select(), self.agent)
222                     self.console.print(f"[cyan]Model architecture selected:[/cyan] {ml_model_arch}")
223 
224                     # project dataset setup
225                     if self.plan.data_kind is None:
226                         self.plan.data_kind = req_based_generator(self.requirement, pmpt_dataset_detect(), self.agent)
227                         if self.plan.data_kind == 'no_data_information_provided':
228                             self.plan.dataset = req_based_generator(self.requirement, pmpt_dataset_select(), self.agent)
229                         elif self.plan.data_kind == 'csv_table_data':
230                             self.plan.dataset = questionary.text("Please provide the CSV data path:").ask()
231 
232                     self.console.print(f"[cyan]Data source:[/cyan] {self.plan.dataset}")
233                     if self.plan.dataset is None:
234                         raise SystemExit("The dataset information is not provided. Aborted.")
235 
236                     with self.console.status("Planning the tasks for you..."):
237                         # generate the plan and tasks.
238                         task_dicts = plan_generator(
239                             self.requirement,
240                             self.agent,
241                             ml_model_arch,
242                             self.plan.dataset,
243                             ml_task_name
244                         )
245                         self.console.print(task_dicts)
246                         self.plan.tasks = []
247                         for task_dict in task_dicts.get('tasks'):
248                             task = match_plan(task_dict)
249                             if task:
250                                 self.plan.tasks.append(task)
251 
252                     # confirm the plan.
253                     confirm_plan = questionary.confirm("Are you sure to use this plan?").ask()
254                     if confirm_plan:
255                         self.update_project_state()
256                     else:
257                         self.console.print("Seems you are not satisfied with the plan. Aborting the chain.")
258                         return
259 
260                 task_params = None
261                 task_num = len(self.plan.tasks)
262                 # check if all tasks are completed.
263                 if self.plan.current_task == task_num:
264                     self.console.log(":tada: Looks like all tasks are completed.")
265                     return
266 
267                 # install the dependencies for this plan.
268                 with self.console.status("Installing the dependencies for the plan..."):
269                     install_commands = dependency_generator(self.plan, self.agent).get('commands')
270                     self.console.log(f"[cyan]Commands are going to execute:[/cyan] {install_commands}")
271 
272                 # confirm the installation.
273                 confirm_install = questionary.confirm("Are you sure to install the dependencies?").ask()
274                 if confirm_install:
275                     run_command(install_commands)
276                 else:
277                     self.console.print("Skipped the dependencies installation.")
278 
279                 for task in self.plan.tasks:
280                     if self.plan.current_task < task_num:
281                         self.console.log(f"Working on task: {task.name} ({self.plan.current_task + 1}/{task_num})")
282                         # TODO: add supports for other kind of tasks.
283                         if task.kind == 'code_generation':
284                             result = self.gen_task_content(task)
285                             if result is None:
286                                 self.console.log("[red]Task failed. Aborting the chain.")
287                                 return
288 
289                         self.plan.current_task += 1
290                     self.update_project_state()
291 
292                 is_running = False
293         except KeyboardInterrupt:
294             self.console.print("The chain has been interrupted.")
295             return
intended_behavior: Enhance the start method to include a step for confirming or refining the detected task and model architecture after the user provides data input. This confirmation helps ensure that the generated tasks and model architecture align more precisely with the provided data, thus avoiding overly general plans based solely on vague requirements. The existing functionality and flow should be preserved, with the added confirmation improving the accuracy of task generation.
